question: In what different combinations can these factors arise at the limited level?
premises: The limiting factors may arise otherwise or together.
They may arise in pairs, in threes, or all together.
They may even arise by combinations of four or five at the limited level.
inference: At the limited level, the limiting factors can manifest in multiple possible groupings rather than in only one fixed order.
plain_english: At the limited level, these factors may arise otherwise or together, in pairs or in threes, all at once, or even in combinations of four or five.
